product_overview: A mobile-first web application to replace paper-based sanitation checklists for bottling lines, capturing timestamped checklist entries, photos, drafts and providing an admin dashboard for review, approval and PDF export. (See PRD pages 1-2 for project objectives, personas and dashboard requirements.)
core_goals: Replace manual paper checklists with a mobile-first web app optimized for tablet use (gloved hands).
Capture start/end automatic timestamps, photos, mandatory notes for failures, and allow partial (draft) saves and handoffs between operators.
Provide an admin dashboard to list, filter, preview, approve/deny submissions and export PDF audit records.
Enforce role-based access (operator vs admin), record audit trails (who edited/approved with timestamps), and require secure authentication.
Retain sanitation records for 2 years for compliance and support offline retry/resubmission in case of network failures.
Be scalable to support multiple production sites (~5) and ~2,000 employees with high availability.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Operators and admins sign in with email/password to receive a JWT; authenticated requests use the token to access protected APIs and fetch current user profile.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with { user, token }
GET /api/auth/me with valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with User profile
POST /api/auth/login with missing email or password -> Receive 400 'Email and password required'
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 'Invalid credentials'

features.name: User Management
features.description: Admin-only CRUD for user accounts (create, list, update role, delete). Operators can view their own profile but cannot manage users.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with admin token
POST /api/users with admin token and body { name, email, password, role } -> Receive 201 with created User
GET /api/users with admin token -> Receive 200 with User[]
PUT /api/users/:id with admin token and body { role } -> Receive 200 with updated User
DELETE /api/users/:id with admin token -> Receive 204 No content
POST /api/users with missing required fields (admin token) -> Receive 400 'Missing required fields'
POST /api/users with email that already exists (admin token) -> Receive 409 'Email already exists'
POST /api/auth/login with operator credentials -> Receive 200 with operator token
POST /api/users with operator token -> Receive 403 Forbidden (admin only)
PUT /api/users/:id with admin token for non-existent id -> Receive 404 'User not found'
DELETE /api/users/:id with admin token for non-existent id -> Receive 404 'User not found'

features.name: Production Lines
features.description: Read-only listing of production lines (Line 91, 92, 93, etc.) for operators to select when creating a checklist.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with token
GET /api/lines with valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with Line[]
GET /api/lines without token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/lines with invalid/expired token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Checklist Templates
features.description: Manage checklist templates (list, get by id). Admins can create and delete templates used to generate checklists for a production line.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with admin token
POST /api/templates with admin token and body { title, lineId, machines } -> Receive 201 with Template
GET /api/templates with valid token -> Receive 200 with Template[]
GET /api/templates/:id with valid token and existing id -> Receive 200 with Template
GET /api/templates/:id with valid token and unknown id -> Receive 404 'Template not found'
POST /api/templates with admin token and missing required fields -> Receive 400 'Missing required fields'
DELETE /api/templates/:id with admin token -> Receive 204 No content
POST /api/auth/login with operator credentials -> Receive 200 with operator token
POST /api/templates with operator token -> Receive 403 Forbidden (admin only)

features.name: Checklists Management
features.description: Full checklist lifecycle: create checklists from templates by line, update checklist items (machines), save drafts, submit for review, admin approve/deny, delete, list/filter, and export PDF for audit.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with operator credentials -> Receive 200 with operator token
POST /api/checklists with operator token and body { lineId } -> Receive 201 with Checklist
PUT /api/checklists/:id/items with operator token and body { machines } -> Receive 200 with updated Checklist
POST /api/checklists/:id/submit with operator token -> Receive 200 with Checklist (status: submitted)
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with admin token
POST /api/checklists/:id/approve with admin token -> Receive 200 with Checklist (status: approved)
GET /api/checklists/:id/pdf with admin token -> Receive 200 application/pdf
GET /api/checklists with token and query ?status=submitted&lineId=91 -> Receive 200 with Checklist[] (filtered results)
POST /api/checklists with operator token when no template is available for the selected line -> Receive 400 'No template available'
POST /api/checklists with operator token and invalid lineId -> Receive 404 'Line not found or User not found'
PUT /api/checklists/:id/items with operator token when checklist cannot be edited -> Receive 400 'Cannot update items on this checklist'
POST /api/checklists/:id/submit with operator token for non-existent id -> Receive 404 'Checklist not found'
POST /api/checklists/:id/deny with admin token -> Receive 200 with Checklist (status: denied)
DELETE /api/checklists/:id with admin token -> Receive 204 No content
DELETE /api/checklists/:id with admin token for non-existent id -> Receive 404 'Checklist not found'
GET /api/checklists/:id/pdf with operator token (non-admin) -> Receive 403 Forbidden (admin only)
